structuralChanges.description: Bound Star Thread bank pauses weekly inflow without erasing old balances; production and model use the same grant function.
Showcase Thread fitting cost stays fixed per shelf so every permanent upgrade remains affordable under a small bank.
Native item qualities and completed-route origins replace reconstructed qualities and encounter-count reward eligibility.
V3 guaranteed Legendary tailoring has its own recipe and distinct-earned-seal proof requirement; legacy C2 stays separate.
Confirmed deterministic studio burns can earn a capped Spool rebate; all accounts use the same quote and repeated finalization cannot duplicate credit.

pareto.reason: The same public rewards and paid craft rebates are available to automated accounts. The modeled spending mix still misses the bot ratio; finite collections, available YARN, and Thread constrain higher prices.

The bot objective fits these pilot seeds, but the listed balance or tail objectives still miss. Reducing passive grants, craft affordability, and finite desired collections trade off against one another.
